name: Test Scheduled

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - releases/*
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - '**/*.md'
      - '**/*.txt'
      - '**/.gitignore'
      - '**/.editorconfig'
      - '**/.prettierrc'
      - '**/.eslintrc.js'
      - '**/.stylelintrc.css'
      - '**/.php-cs-fixer.dist.php'
      - '**/Dockerfile'
      - '**/docker-compose.yml'

jobs:
  test-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        php-version: ['8.4', '8.2']
        db-type: ['maria', 'mysql']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}
          extensions: pdo_mysql, mysqli
          coverage: pcov
          tools: composer, phpunit

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: .
          ignore-cache: true

      - name: Wait for MySQL
        run: |
          until mysqladmin ping -h ${{ secrets.MYSQL_HOST }} -u ${{ secrets.MYSQL_USER }} -p${{ secrets.MYSQL_PASSWORD }} --silent; do
            echo "Waiting for MySQL..."
            sleep 5
          done

      - name: Run tests
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text --colors=always

  test-master:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test-pr
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: pdo_mysql, mysqli
          coverage: pcov
          tools: composer, phpunit

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: .
          ignore-cache: true

      - name: Run full test suite
        run: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text --colors=always

  collect-coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test-master
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.4'
          extensions: pdo_mysql, mysqli
          coverage: pcov
          tools: composer, phpunit

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          working-directory: .
          ignore-cache: true

      - name: Combine coverage
        run: vendor/bin/pcov merge --report-html ./coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./coverage
          flags: pr
